upstream.role: fixed C allocator oracle; this crabc-authored fixture uses only the selected production shadow C ABI

ownership_contract: A fresh helper frees one selected ordinary C address while the allocating worker remains live.
Every owner returns normally with six ordinary C blocks still live.
After pthread_join confirms that owner exit, the initial thread validates malloc_usable_size and frees every surviving C address in a seed-derived order.
The fixture never transfers an allocator-private pointer, page, heap, route, or metadata capability.

state_observation.reason: This selected C ABI has no allocator-statistics or debug-state API. The smoke records null rather than deriving metadata from Rust internals, a C fallback, or an unsupported proxy.

scope.classification: C ABI compatibility machinery and native allocator evidence
non_claims: This bounded smoke is not a general owner-exit, allocator metadata, PageMap, arena, or selected-shadow promotion proof.
It does not infer a metadata plateau from RSS or workload liveness.
It does not replace the separately owned upstream stress, differential, state-auditor, soak, performance, or architecture-ratchet evidence.
